Claims (20)
-----------

We claim:

**1**. A compound having a formula (I)

or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, wherein

R1 is a C1-C12 alkyl;

R2 is a C1-C12 alkyl; and

R3 is an acyl, alkyl, alkenyl, alkynyl, heteroalkyl, heteroalkenyl, heteroalkynyl, cycloalkyl, heterocyloalkyl, cycloalkenyl, heterocycloakenyl, heterocyclyl, or an optionally substituted aryl, arylalkyl, or arylalkenyl.

**2**. The compound according to claim 1, wherein R1 is ethyl.

**3**. The compound according to claim 1, wherein R2 is methyl.

**4**. The compound according to claim 1, wherein said compound has a formula (II)
